These fees will not be charged if the filing is rejected. Two Business Days: $50 Five Business Days: $15

notes: Iowa prices expedite in days rather than hours, and at the bottom end very cheaply — $15 buys a five-business-day commitment. Two things set it apart from every other record here so far: the fee is explicitly not charged when the filing is rejected, which is the opposite of North Carolina and New York, and the office also sells a separate preclearance review that checks a document before submission without issuing a filing date. Iowa lists document types for which expedited service is not available; whether a Certificate of Organization is among them is not asserted from the excerpt read.
needsReview: Two items: (1) confirm a Certificate of Organization is not on the excluded-documents list on this page; (2) standard processing time, not researched.

sources.title: Preclearance and Expedited Services — Two Business Days $50, Five Business Days $15, per document, refunded on rejection
